metadata.title: Packablock Micro-Enterprise CRA Sector Classification & Provenance Crosswalk
standards_referenced: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 (Statistical Classification of Economic Activities)
United Nations ISIC Rev. 4 (International Standard Industrial Classification)
US Census NAICS 2022 (North American Industry Classification System)

records.category_name: Consumer Mobile Applications (iOS / Android)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Commercial mobile binaries distributed via app stores fall under software publishing (NACE J58.29). Classified as Default PDE under CRA Article 18(1) requiring Annex II Module A self-assessment.

records.category_name: macOS Menu-Bar & Productivity Utilities
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Packaged desktop productivity software directly commercialized to end users. Under CRA Article 3(1), independent desktop utilities constitute products with digital elements.

records.category_name: Windows Desktop System Tools & Tweakers
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Low-level system utility software distributed with installer binaries. Requires software bill of materials (SBOM) under Art. 13(18) and vulnerability disclosure under Art. 14.

records.category_name: Desktop Indie Games (Steam / Epic Games Store)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 58.21 Publishing of computer games
records.classification_provenance_notes: Commercial gaming software distributed on digital storefronts is explicitly covered under CRA scope as PDE. Video game publishers mapped directly to NACE J58.21.

records.category_name: Audio DSP, VST/AU Music Plugins & Synthesizers
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Digital signal processing audio software plugins commercialized to musicians/studios. Mapped to software publishing under NACE J58.29 and Default PDE under CRA.

records.category_name: Electron & Tauri Cross-Platform Desktop Apps
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Hybrid web-technology standalone desktop applications bundling Node.js, Chromium, or system webviews. Heightened SBOM exposure under Art. 13(18) due to large bundled dependency graphs.

records.category_name: Developer CLI, TUI & Developer Productivity Binaries
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 62.01 Computer programming activities
records.classification_provenance_notes: Command-line tools commercialized directly to engineers. Mapped to NACE J62.01 and Default PDE under CRA Article 18(1).

records.category_name: Bluetooth LE & Local IoT Companion Mobile Apps
records.primary_delivery_form: Mobile App + Local Radio Protocol Handler
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Art. 18(2), Annex III Class I, Art. 53
records.public_data_source_title: European Parliament & Council Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 (CRA Annex III)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Mobile companion applications interfacing directly with local network interfaces or microcontrollers trigger Important Class I Annex III exposure when managing smart home devices or radio interfaces.

records.category_name: WordPress Security, Backup & Admin Tools
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Art. 18(2), Annex III Class I (Security Software), Art. 53
records.public_data_source_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex III Item 1 (Security Systems & Tools)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Plugins providing security functions (authentication, firewall, vulnerability scanning) qualify as Important Class I under Annex III Item 1, with statutory presumption of conformity only via European harmonised standards.

records.category_name: WooCommerce Payment Gateways & Invoicing Plugins
records.primary_delivery_form: PHP Plugin Package with API Bridge
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: E-commerce transactional middleware packages. Mapped to NACE J62.01. Heightened civil liability under the new EU Product Liability Directive (2024/2853) for financial transaction defects.

records.category_name: Shopify Public Marketplace Apps & Frontends
records.nace_rev21_title: Data processing, hosting and related activities
records.isic_rev4_title: Data processing, hosting and related activities
records.naics_2022_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting
records.cra_statutory_module: Exempt unless embedding executable client-side JS runtime
records.classification_provenance_notes: Pure cloud-hosted SaaS applications interacting via APIs are governed by NIS2 rather than CRA under Recital 13, unless distributed with downloadable client scripts or themes.

records.category_name: PrestaShop & Magento Commercial E-Com Modules
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Downloadable PHP module packages executed on self-hosted customer infrastructure constitute standalone PDE under CRA Article 3(1).

records.category_name: Browser Extensions (Chrome Web Store / Firefox Add-ons)
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Annex III Class I Item 5 (Web Browsers & Extensions)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Browser extensions execute directly within the web browser DOM with elevated privileges. Under CRA Annex III Item 5, web browsers and associated security-relevant browser components fall into Important Class I.

records.category_name: IDE & Developer Tool Extensions (VS Code / JetBrains)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Packaged development plugins executing in local IDE process spaces. Regulated as Default PDE under Article 18(1).

records.category_name: Headless CMS Commercial Extensions (Strapi / Contentful)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Commercial NPM middleware distributed for headless CMS platforms. Mapped to computer programming activities under NACE J62.01.

records.category_name: Slack, Discord & Microsoft Teams Bot Integrations
records.nace_rev21_title: Data processing, hosting and related activities
records.isic_rev4_title: Data processing, hosting and related activities
records.naics_2022_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting
records.cra_statutory_module: Exempt unless distributing executable local connector
records.classification_provenance_notes: Cloud-hosted bot integrations communicating over OAuth/webhooks are generally exempt from CRA manufacturer duties unless shipping on-premises daemon components.

records.category_name: Retro Gaming Handhelds & Flash Carts
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Art. 13, Art. 32-34 (CE Marking), Art. 48 (Customs)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 26.40 Manufacture of consumer electronics
records.classification_provenance_notes: Physical consumer hardware with bootable firmware. Triggers mandatory CE marking and Article 48 customs controls at EU external borders.

records.category_name: Custom Mechanical Keyboards & Macropads (QMK/ZMK)
records.nace_rev21_title: Manufacture of computers and peripheral equipment
records.isic_rev4_title: Manufacture of computers and peripheral equipment
records.naics_2022_title: Computer Terminal and Other Computer Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 26.20 Manufacture of computers and peripheral equipment
records.classification_provenance_notes: Computer input peripherals with embedded programmable microcontrollers. Covered under NACE C26.20 and subject to CRA Article 10 security-by-design standards.

records.category_name: Smart Home Environmental Sensors (Matter / Zigbee / ESP32)
records.naics_2022_title: Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Annex III Class I Item 14 (Smart Home Devices), Art. 48
records.public_data_source_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex III Item 14 (Smart Home Devices)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Connected home environmental monitoring hardware. Explicitly classified as Important Class I under Annex III Item 14, requiring conformity against harmonised radio/cybersecurity standards.

records.category_name: Ham Radio, SDR Transceivers & RF Testing Boards
records.naics_2022_title: Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Art. 13, Art. 32-34, Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 26.30 Manufacture of communication equipment
records.classification_provenance_notes: Software-defined radio instruments and transceivers. Must satisfy both CRA Article 10 and RED Article 3.3 cybersecurity requirements.

records.category_name: 3D Printer Mainboards, Toolheads & Klipper Accelerators
records.isic_rev4_title: Manufacture of electronic components and boards
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 26.11 Manufacture of electronic components
records.classification_provenance_notes: Microcontroller mainboards intended for integration into 3D printing equipment. Commercialized as components or standalone upgrades under Article 3(1).

records.category_name: Eurorack DSP Synth Modules & MIDI Controllers
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 26.40 Manufacture of consumer electronics
records.classification_provenance_notes: Embedded digital synthesizers and MIDI communication modules. Falls into consumer electronics manufacturing under NACE C26.40.

records.category_name: Automotive Diagnostic OBD-II / CAN Dongles & Loggers
records.nace_rev21_title: Manufacture of instruments and appliances for measuring, testing and navigation
records.isic_rev4_title: Manufacture of measuring, testing, navigating and control equipment
records.naics_2022_title: Instrument Manufacturing for Measuring and Testing Electricity and Electrical Signals
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Annex III Class I, UNECE WP.29 R155/R156, Art. 48
records.public_data_source_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex III & UNECE WP.29 Automotive Cybersecurity
records.classification_provenance_notes: Vehicle telematics diagnostic equipment interfacing with safety-critical CAN networks. Intersects with UNECE cybersecurity regulations and Annex III Class I.

records.category_name: Agricultural & Environmental Remote IoT Nodes
records.nace_rev21_title: Manufacture of instruments and appliances for measuring, testing and navigation
records.isic_rev4_title: Manufacture of measuring, testing, navigating and control equipment
records.naics_2022_title: Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 26.51 Manufacture of instruments for measuring
records.classification_provenance_notes: Field environmental monitoring and agricultural telemetry stations. Subject to CE marking and Module A self-assessment under Article 18(1).

records.category_name: Commercial SaaS Boilerplates, Starters & Code Kits
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Commercial starter kits and boilerplates sold to developers. When commercialized as packaged software, covered under software publishing NACE J58.29.

records.category_name: Bespoke Mobile Apps Delivered Under Client Brand
records.primary_delivery_form: Turnkey Client Codebase + App Store Release
records.cra_statutory_tier: Default Product with Digital Elements (Client Manufacturer)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Contractual Deliverable Handoff)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 62.01 Computer programming activities
records.classification_provenance_notes: Custom software development for specific clients. Under CRA Article 13(20), when software is placed on the market under the client's trademark, the client is statutory manufacturer, but agencies face contractual indemnification risk.

records.category_name: Headless E-Commerce Frontends (Next.js / Shopify Hydrogen)
records.cra_statutory_module: Client Infrastructure Integration (Module A)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Cloud-hosted web frontends built for enterprise merchants. Primarily subject to client MSA terms and security warranties.

records.category_name: Custom Agency WordPress Themes & Tailored Stacks
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Bespoke CMS themes commercialized to corporate clients. Subject to CRA Article 10 security-by-design standards if distributed or reused across clients.

records.category_name: Embedded Firmware & IoT Prototypes Built for Clients
records.nace_rev21_title: Engineering activities and related technical consultancy
records.isic_rev4_title: Engineering activities and related technical consultancy
records.cra_statutory_tier: Default Product with Digital Elements (Client Placed on Market)
records.cra_statutory_module: Technical Construction File (Annex II Module A)
records.public_data_source_title: Eurostat NACE Rev. 2.1 - Class 71.12 Engineering activities
records.classification_provenance_notes: Contract engineering and firmware prototyping. Classified under NACE M71.12. Agency must supply full technical file documentation to enable client CE declaration.

records.category_name: Internal Corporate Portals & B2B Admin Dashboards
records.isic_rev4_title: Computer consultancy and computer facilities management activities
records.cra_statutory_module: Contractual Security Specification
records.classification_provenance_notes: Internal enterprise administrative tools developed for single corporate use are governed primarily by client cybersecurity policies rather than public market placing rules.

records.category_name: Custom ETL Data Pipelines & API Middleware
records.cra_statutory_module: Client Infrastructure Integration
records.classification_provenance_notes: Cloud-native middleware connecting enterprise data systems. Falls under programming activities (NACE J62.01).

records.category_name: White-Label FinTech & Checkout Flow Integrations
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Embeddable payment libraries and financial components. High contractual liability exposure for software defects under the revised Product Liability Directive.

records.category_name: Cloud B2B SaaS with CLI Management Companion
records.nace_rev21_title: Data processing, hosting and related activities
records.isic_rev4_title: Data processing, hosting and related activities
records.naics_2022_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting
records.cra_statutory_tier: Default Product with Digital Elements (CLI Component Only)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control on CLI)
records.public_data_source_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Article 3 & Recital 13 Hybrid SaaS Boundary
records.classification_provenance_notes: While central cloud SaaS is exempt under Recital 13, any downloadable native CLI binary distributed to customer terminals constitutes a product with digital elements under Art. 3(1).

records.category_name: SaaS Platform with Desktop File Sync Client
records.cra_statutory_tier: Default Product with Digital Elements (Desktop Agent)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Local filesystem synchronization daemons installed on endpoint workstations fall directly under CRA manufacturer duties for security updates and SBOM generation.

records.category_name: Web Collaboration SaaS with Mobile Push Companion
records.primary_delivery_form: SaaS App + iOS/Android Mobile Push Clients
records.cra_statutory_tier: Default Product with Digital Elements (Mobile App Binary)
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Mobile companion applications published to Apple App Store or Google Play Store are evaluated as standalone software products requiring CE documentation.

records.category_name: Self-Hosted Docker Compose / Helm Distributions
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Container images distributed to customer infrastructure for on-premises hosting are fully within CRA PDE scope, losing SaaS cloud exemptions under Recital 13.

records.category_name: On-Premises Kubernetes DaemonSets & Observability Exporters
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Kernel and container instrumentation probes executing with elevated node privileges in customer clusters. Subject to strict SBOM and vulnerability reporting.

records.category_name: Cloud Backup Local Agent & Volume Snapshot Daemons
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Annex III Class I Item 6 (Backup Systems), Art. 53
records.public_data_source_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex III Item 6 (Backup & Restore Software)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Software systems designed for backup and data recovery are specifically enumerated in CRA Annex III Class I Item 6, requiring conformity assessment under Article 18(2).

records.category_name: Remote Support, Screen-Share & MDM Control Clients
records.cra_statutory_tier: Important Product with Digital Elements — Class I (Annex III)
records.cra_statutory_module: Harmonised Standards (Module A) / Notified Body (Module B+C)
records.cra_primary_articles: Art. 3, Art. 10, Annex III Class I Item 4 (Remote Access / Administration), Art. 53
records.public_data_source_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 Annex III Item 4 (Remote Access Software)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Remote administration and control client software is explicitly classified under CRA Annex III Class I Item 4 due to elevated privileged attack surface.

records.category_name: Self-Hosted CI/CD Runner Daemons & Build Agents
records.cra_statutory_module: Annex II Module A (Internal Production Control)
records.classification_provenance_notes: Standalone build orchestration daemons executed inside customer VPCs/networks. Commercialized as downloadable software and covered under CRA Article 3.
